التحقوا (form VIII)
# اِلْتَحَقُوا (iltaḥaqū) /il.ta.ħa.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# اُلْتُحِقُوا (ultuḥiqū) /ul.tu.ħi.quː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# اِلْتَحِقُوا (iltaḥiqū) /il.ta.ħi.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
